cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline coding tutor grounded via RAG in Think Python (Allen Downey), teaching intro-level Python to CS students in low-connectivity settings, with a refusal-to-solve-directly pedagogy design.

test_prompts.prompt: Write a Python function that reads a CSV file and returns the column with the highest mean value.
Explain the difference between a list and a tuple in Python, and give one example where each is the better choice.
